---
title: "Use the Calendar screen"
subtitle: "SOP GRM-12 · Groomer manual"
---

## Purpose

See the shop's bookings, past grooms and vaccine expiry dates by month and
by day.

## Applies to

Every groomer.

## Before you begin

- You are signed in to your profile.

## Procedure

1. Click **Calendar** at the top of the screen, next to **Check-in**. The
   Calendar screen opens on the current month.

   ![The Calendar screen](/screenshots/groomer/calendar.png)

2. To move between months, click **‹** (previous month) or **›** (next
   month). To come back to this month, click **Today**.
3. To choose what the calendar shows, click **Bookings**, **Grooms** or
   **Vaccine expiries** above the calendar. A highlighted button is shown;
   click it again to hide it.
4. Click a day. The right side of the screen lists everything on that day
   and the groomers' schedules for it.
5. Click a dog's name in the day's list to open its card on the Check-in
   screen.

### See one dog only

1. Click **Focus calendar view:** and type the dog's or owner's name, then
   click the dog. The calendar shows only that dog, with the date it was
   last groomed.
2. To see every dog again, click **Show every dog**.

You can also open the calendar for one dog from its card: click **▸ More
details: vaccinations, last visit, contact**, then **See on the calendar**.

## Reading the calendar

| What you see | What it means |
|---|---|
| Outlined in the shop's colour | **Booked**: a groom booked for that day |
| Filled in the shop's colour | **Groomed**: a groom that was done |
| Red | **Expires and stops grooms (rabies)** |
| Amber | **Expires, groom can go ahead** |
| Green check mark | **All vaccines current** |

## Result

The Calendar screen shows the month or the dog you chose, and the day you
clicked.
